name: José Pinhal Post-Mortem Experience Farewell Concert
description: Don't miss the final, poignant performance from the cult tribute band that resurrected the music of a forgotten legend. A unique piece of Porto's recent musical history comes to a close at the city's grandest venue.
longDescription:
The José Pinhal Post-Mortem Experience presents its farewell concert at Coliseu Porto Ageas on October 9, 2026. This performance marks the culmination of the tribute band's journey, which began with the aim of reintroducing the work of José Pinhal, a Portuguese musician whose career was cut short and largely overlooked. The band formed to interpret and perform Pinhal's original compositions, bringing his distinctive sound to new audiences and establishing a dedicated following for his posthumous legacy.

Attendees can expect a concert experience celebrating Pinhal's unique musical style, delivered by the band that has championed his work for years. The event takes place in the grand setting of Coliseu Porto Ageas, a historic and prominent venue in the city, known for hosting significant musical and cultural events. The atmosphere will reflect the band's final performance, drawing an audience familiar with their interpretations and the original artist's material.

This is a ticketed event. Information regarding ticket availability and purchase will be released closer to the date. Coliseu Porto Ageas is centrally located and accessible via public transport, including Bolhão metro station, which is a short walk away.
